json.hint:
Nothing in the offline Ultimate Guitar index matches well. UG's sitemaps list some artists only by bare ids, usually because of accents or non-Latin letters (Joaquín Sabina, Maná, 宋冬野), so caracole can't see their tabs. If E.G.O. is the artist's name, find their page on ultimate-guitar.com once, or one of their tab pages, and paste its address, as your browser shows it (an artist page's ends in the artist's number, as …/artist/634073 does), into overrides.toml:

    [artist_url]
    "E.G.O." = "https://www.ultimate-guitar.com/artist/…"

The key is the artist's name as your songs write it, so take any title words out of it. Then add the song with `caracole add`; the nightly run looks for its tabs on that page.

If E.G.O. is a title, caracole needs its artist too: `caracole add ARTIST "E.G.O."`.

json.hint:
Nothing in the offline Ultimate Guitar index matches well. UG's sitemaps list some artists only by bare ids, usually because of accents or non-Latin letters (Joaquín Sabina, Maná, 宋冬野), so caracole can't see their tabs. If alejandro sanz is the artist's name, find their page on ultimate-guitar.com once, or one of their tab pages, and paste its address, as your browser shows it (an artist page's ends in the artist's number, as …/artist/634073 does), into overrides.toml:

    [artist_url]
    "alejandro sanz" = "https://www.ultimate-guitar.com/artist/…"

The key is the artist's name as your songs write it, so take any title words out of it. Then add the song with `caracole add`; the nightly run looks for its tabs on that page.

If alejandro sanz is a title, caracole needs its artist too: `caracole add ARTIST "alejandro sanz"`.

json.hint:
Nothing in the offline Ultimate Guitar index matches well. UG's sitemaps list some artists only by bare ids, usually because of accents or non-Latin letters (Joaquín Sabina, Maná, 宋冬野), so caracole can't see their tabs. If nothing is the artist's name, find their page on ultimate-guitar.com once, or one of their tab pages, and paste its address, as your browser shows it (an artist page's ends in the artist's number, as …/artist/634073 does), into overrides.toml:

    [artist_url]
    "nothing" = "https://www.ultimate-guitar.com/artist/…"

The key is the artist's name as your songs write it, so take any title words out of it. Then add the song with `caracole add`; the nightly run looks for its tabs on that page.

If nothing is a title, caracole needs its artist too: `caracole add ARTIST "nothing"`.

    [artist_url]
    "Ünd" = "https://www.ultimate-guitar.com/artist/…"

The key is the artist's name as your songs write it, so take any title words out of it. Then add the song with `caracole add`; the nightly run looks for its tabs on that page.

If Ünd is a title, caracole needs its artist too: `caracole add ARTIST "Ünd"`.

The key is the artist's name as your songs write it, so take any title words out of it. Then add the song with `caracole add`; the nightly run looks for its tabs on that page.

If lynrd skynrd is a title, caracole needs its artist too: `caracole add ARTIST "lynrd skynrd"`.

json.hint:
Nothing in the offline Ultimate Guitar index matches well. UG's sitemaps list some artists only by bare ids, usually because of accents or non-Latin letters (Joaquín Sabina, Maná, 宋冬野), so caracole can't see their tabs. If billy joel uptown girl is the artist's name, find their page on ultimate-guitar.com once, or one of their tab pages, and paste its address, as your browser shows it (an artist page's ends in the artist's number, as …/artist/634073 does), into overrides.toml:

    [artist_url]
    "billy joel uptown girl" = "https://www.ultimate-guitar.com/artist/…"

The key is the artist's name as your songs write it, so take any title words out of it. Then add the song with `caracole add`; the nightly run looks for its tabs on that page.

If billy joel uptown girl is a title, caracole needs its artist too: `caracole add ARTIST "billy joel uptown girl"`.
